title: The Maratha Advance Into Doab And Punjab Second Phase
definition: The second phase of Maratha expansion (1757–1758) represents the zenith of Maratha territorial ambition under the Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao, characterized by the expulsion of Afghan garrisons from Punjab and the establishment of Maratha suzerainty over the Indus region.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is critical for understanding the geopolitical vacuum in 18th-century India, the shift from regional power to imperial contenders, and the direct causal link to the Third Battle of Panipat (1761).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Maratha Advance Into Doab And Punjab Second Phase.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
